blocks_element.repere: Bouton ou lien · Why should I choose SURI over other el…
blocks_element.text: Why should I choose SURI over other electric toothbrushes?

SURI brings together clinically-tested sonic cleaning, thoughtful design and everyday convenience. With a pressure sensor, over four weeks of battery life, a slim aluminium body and innovative plant-based heads, everything is designed to make brushing feel effortless. No unnecessary extras, just a great clean you'll look forward to, twice a day.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton ou lien · What makes sonic different from ‘round…
blocks_element.text: What makes sonic different from ‘round headed’ brushes?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · A sonic toothbrush, like SURI, doesn’t…
blocks_element.text:
A sonic toothbrush, like SURI, doesn’t only clean with its bristles.

As the brush head vibrates at high speed, it sets the fluid around your teeth in motion. That movement helps to lift away plaque in places the bristles may not directly reach, including between teeth and below the gumline. The bristles still do the heavy lifting, but fluid dynamics helps the clean go even further.

The familiar oval head shape and brushing motion feel instantly intuitive rather than a new technique to learn. And with a quiet sonic motor, you get a powerful clean without the harsh buzz of a traditional electric toothbrush.
